name: Machhar Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Machhar Industries Ltd is in the business of conversion of Ammonium Nitrate Melt into Solid form on a Job work basis, and production of Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF)[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MIL specialises in converting Ammonium Nitrate from melt form to solid form, in accordance 
with the specific terms and requirements of its customers. In addition to this core activity,
 the company is also engaged in the transportation of Ammonium Nitrate and trading of its AdBlue (Diesel Exhaust Fluid), and other 
chemical products.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -3.14% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.95% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
